items.text: NVIDIA highlighted Kumo, an open foundation model for tabular data developed by the Kumo team.
items.text_zh: 英伟达展示了 Kumo 团队开发的表格数据开放基础模型。
items.cat_take_en: Open tabular modeling could lower the barrier for enterprise analytics, but deployment quality remains unproven.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放表格模型有望降低企业分析门槛，但实际部署质量仍待验证。

items.text: NVIDIA said Physis-Lang ranked first on the Physics-IQ verified image-to-video leaderboard with Cosmos models.
items.text_zh: 英伟达称，基于 Cosmos 模型的 Physis-Lang 登上 Physics-IQ 图生视频榜首。
items.cat_take_en: The result rewards physics-aware generation, yet leaderboard gains do not guarantee reliable real-world video simulation.
items.cat_take_zh: 榜首说明物理一致性提升，但榜单成绩仍不能证明现实模拟可靠。

items.text: Liquid AI released d1, a decision model that returns calibrated probabilities without generating output tokens.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 发布 d1 决策模型，可返回校准概率而无需生成输出 token。
items.cat_take_en: Zero-output inference could make routing cheaper, but calibration—not headline accuracy—will determine production value.
items.cat_take_zh: 零输出推理可能降低路由成本，但生产价值取决于校准而非宣传准确率。

items.text: MongoDB announced a partnership that pairs Cognition’s Devin with its application-modernization platform.
items.text_zh: MongoDB 宣布与 Cognition 合作，将 Devin 接入其应用现代化平台。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding Devin into modernization workflows targets costly legacy work, but enterprise adoption depends on auditability and rollback.
items.cat_take_zh: Devin 切入遗留系统现代化这一高成本环节，但企业仍需审计与回滚能力。

items.text: OpenAI introduced a Decisions API powered by GPT-6 Luna for classification, routing, and other real-time choices.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 推出由 GPT-6 Luna 驱动的 Decisions API，用于分类、路由等实时决策。
items.cat_take_en: Structured decisions could reduce glue code for agents, while opaque labels may make errors harder to challenge.
items.cat_take_zh: 结构化决策可减少 Agent 胶水代码，但不透明标签会增加纠错难度。

items.text: OpenAI said Codex Security Cloud now includes cyber-capable Daybreak Blue models and scans entire GitHub repositories.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 称 Codex Security Cloud 已默认加入具备网络安全能力的 Daybreak Blue 模型，并可扫描完整 GitHub 仓库。
items.cat_take_en: Repository-wide scanning expands agentic security coverage, but default cyber capability raises permission and disclosure risks.
items.cat_take_zh: 全仓扫描扩大安全覆盖，但默认启用网络安全模型也提高权限与披露风险。

items.text: Figma said GPT-6.1 Sol is now available inside Figma Make for AI-assisted app creation.
items.text_zh: Figma 表示，GPT-6.1 Sol 已接入 Figma Make，用于 AI 辅助创建应用。
items.cat_take_en: The integration shortens the design-to-prototype loop, benefiting product teams while increasing dependence on one model vendor.
items.cat_take_zh: 该集成缩短设计到原型的链路，却也加深产品团队对单一模型供应商的依赖。

items.text: Bolt announced the acquisition of AI app-building startup Dokai, citing a shared focus on natural-language software creation.
items.text_zh: Bolt 宣布收购 AI 应用构建初创公司 Dokai，双方都聚焦用自然语言创建软件。
items.cat_take_en: The deal concentrates no-code talent around Bolt, but users may face less ecosystem choice as platforms consolidate.
items.cat_take_zh: 交易将无代码人才集中到 Bolt，但平台整合也可能减少用户选择。

items.text: Simon Willison summarized Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team material on testing advanced models for dangerous capabilities.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 总结了 Anthropic Frontier Red Team 关于测试高级模型危险能力的材料。
items.cat_take_en: Public red-team reporting improves scrutiny, but disclosed attack rates still reveal little about unseen failure modes.
items.cat_take_zh: 公开红队报告提升了审查力度，但已披露攻击率仍无法覆盖未知失效模式。

items.text: Microsoft Research introduced Quine, an early multimodal world-model effort for representing biology across disciplines.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院介绍 Quine，探索用多模态世界模型跨学科表示生物学。
items.cat_take_en: Cross-domain biological representations could aid discovery, but the project is still too early to assess scientific utility.
items.cat_take_zh: 跨领域生物表示或能辅助发现，但项目尚早，科学效用尚无法判断。

items.text: Apple expanded iOS 27 Shortcuts with a “Use Model” action that can query online AI for current information.
items.text_zh: 苹果扩展 iOS 27 快捷指令，新增“使用模型”操作，可联网调用 AI 获取最新信息。
items.cat_take_en: Model-backed shortcuts make automation more timely, but live web answers increase provenance and privacy concerns.
items.cat_take_zh: 模型驱动的快捷指令更及时，但联网答案也放大来源追踪与隐私风险。

items.text: Tesla’s supervised FSD received approval in Croatia, bringing its European availability to eight countries.
items.text_zh: 特斯拉监督版 FSD 获克罗地亚批准，欧洲落地国家增至八个。
items.cat_take_en: The eighth-country approval broadens Tesla’s deployment footprint, while supervision requirements still limit autonomy claims.
items.cat_take_zh: 第八个国家扩大了特斯拉部署版图，但监督要求仍限制其自动驾驶叙事。

items.text: Elon Musk’s AI-powered Grokipedia received another update, according to The Verge.
items.text_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，埃隆·马斯克的 AI 百科 Grokipedia 再次更新。
items.cat_take_en: Frequent updates show xAI is iterating rapidly in knowledge products, but editorial reliability remains the central unresolved risk.
items.cat_take_zh: 频繁更新显示 xAI 正快速迭代知识产品，但内容可靠性仍是核心未解风险。

items.text: OpenAI was reportedly discussing a $30 billion funding round at a valuation of $1.4 trillion.
items.text_zh: 据报道，OpenAI 正洽谈 300 亿美元融资，估值可能达到 1.4 万亿美元。
items.cat_take_en: A valuation at this scale would reward frontier-model momentum, but it also raises expectations for enormous future cash burn.
items.cat_take_zh: 如此高估值奖励了前沿模型势头，却也抬高了未来巨额现金消耗的预期。

items.text: Nebius opened its 2026 Physical AI Awards, offering five prizes worth $150,000 in compute credits.
items.text_zh: Nebius 启动 2026 Physical AI Awards，设置五个价值 15 万美元的算力 créditos 奖项。
items.cat_take_en: Compute grants can widen access to physical-AI experimentation, though credits favor teams already able to use expensive infrastructure.
items.cat_take_zh: 算力奖励能扩大具身智能实验机会，但高昂基础设施仍让资源偏向成熟团队。

items.text: Perplexity released Photon, a Rust-based retrieval engine that reportedly cut p99 latency from 800 milliseconds to 65 milliseconds.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 发布 Rust 编写的 Photon 检索引擎，据称将 p99 延迟从 800 毫秒降至 65 毫秒。
items.cat_take_en: A large latency reduction could improve answer freshness, but the result still needs independent workload testing.
items.cat_take_zh: 延迟大幅下降有助于提升回答时效，但仍需独立工作负载测试验证。

items.text: NVIDIA researchers introduced Physis-Lang, a self-evolving physical-language system that reportedly improved Cosmos results on physics benchmarks.
items.text_zh: NVIDIA 研究人员推出 Physis-Lang，自称在物理基准测试中提升了 Cosmos 的表现。
items.cat_take_en: The result targets a real weakness in generated video—broken physics—but benchmark gains may not equal reliable world understanding.
items.cat_take_zh: 它直击生成视频的物理失真问题，但基准提升不等于可靠的世界理解能力。
